title: SurchargeAdvice
description: A surcharge advice calculates the amount of available surcharge and provides an adjusted transaction total for specific personal account numbers or stored cards. At least one of the following is required to create a surcharge advice request: storedCard, hostedCard, cardNumber, or panToken.

googlePayPayment.description: GooglePayPayment used to create a surcharge advice for a transaction.

applePayPayment.description: ApplePayPayment used to create a surcharge advice for a transaction.

pazePayment.description: PazePayment used to create a surcharge advice for a transaction.

total.description: The transaction total excluding the surcharge amount.

customReference.description: Optional reference provided by the merchant

customFields.description: Custom fields, an object containing arbitrary string values.  Field names and values must not exceed 64 and 1024 characters, respectively.
